name: Herb-Crusted Pork Chop with Sun-Dried Tomato Risotto
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Animator's Palate
whyItWorks: Thick center-cut pork chop and creamy Arborio rice risotto are filling and low-fiber when tough sun-dried tomato bits are avoided.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the pork chop grilled with light salt (no heavy rosemary crust) and request plain risotto or mashed potatoes without sun-dried tomato skins.
watchOuts: Leathery sun-dried tomato pieces in risotto
Woody dried herbs on pork crust
